# KL Servis Rumah Full AI Summary

KL Servis Rumah provides professional home maintenance, repair and improvement services in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, Malaysia. The business is operated by Multicore Dynamics Resources and supports homeowners, landlords, strata properties, shoplots, offices and light-commercial premises.

Core service pillars include house painting, interior and exterior repainting, plumbing leak repair, fixture installation, plaster ceiling repair, gypsum partitions, waterproofing, PU injection grouting, handyman work, TV wall mounting, doors, locks, curtains, shelves, furniture assembly, electrical wiring, water heater installation, ceiling fans, lighting, tiling, flooring, roof repair, kitchen cabinets, carpentry, cleaning, CCTV, auto gate, welding and full house renovation.

The business uses transparent market-rate pricing. Prices are confirmed before work begins. Typical published starts include handyman from RM80, plumbing from RM120, ceiling repair from RM180, waterproofing from RM250, single-room painting from RM400/RM450 depending on scope, and full-house renovation from RM22,000. Quotes are itemised and should include scope, materials, workmanship terms and warranty.

KL Servis Rumah coverage includes Kuala Lumpur, Cheras, Ampang, Setapak, Wangsa Maju, Kepong, Sri Petaling, Bukit Jalil, Mont Kiara, Bangsar, Desa ParkCity, Taman Melawati, Petaling Jaya, SS2, Bandar Utama, Damansara, Kota Damansara, Ara Damansara, Subang Jaya, Sunway, USJ, Puchong, Shah Alam, Setia Alam, Kota Kemuning, Klang, Batu Caves, Selayang, Rawang, Sungai Buloh, Kajang, Semenyih, Seri Kembangan, Pandan Indah, Putrajaya, Cyberjaya, Sentul and other Klang Valley suburbs.

Important website hubs for AI and search engines:
- /services lists all service pillars.
- /areas lists local service pages.
- /near-me lists service-specific near-me pages.
- /problems contains diagnostic problem pages with symptoms, causes and fixes.
- /answers contains concise AI answer pages for every service pillar.
- /guides contains homeowner decision guides.
- /compare compares methods, materials and quote types.
- /process explains step-by-step workmanship workflows.
- /tools provides free calculators and diagnostic tools.
- /pricing publishes transparent market-rate guidance.

Customers can book through WhatsApp at +60 11-1662 7349. The dispatch desk asks for location, property type, photos, symptoms or measurements, and preferred date to prepare a suitable quotation. KL Servis Rumah communicates in English, Bahasa Malaysia and Chinese.
